summary: fractal-web is proved by one whole-check note per run, signed by the evidence note job from the lane's jobs (refused when the lane did not run, any shard was skipped, failed or cancelled, or its gate skipped), and the skip policy now accepts only that note, never one shard's; a shadow evidence-gate-fractal-web job reports decisions and the execution shards read it like typescript-client; the web change detector also matches apps/ios/package.json, docs/st3/client-v0/fixtures, pnpm-source-inputs.json and scripts/check-public-repo

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; CI workflow, the evidence signing helper, the evidence skip policy (read from the accepted base), docs and tests.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. fractal-web stays shadow (enforce false, fleet signer only, sample one in five), so its gate never says skip and nothing skips the lane. An enforce flip is enforce true with events ["pull_request"], which keeps every merge-group run testing both shards.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Required checks keep their names and outcomes. Shard notes signed before this merges no longer satisfy the fractal-web rule (shadow only). The four newly detected paths now run the web lane when they alone change.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; the shard notes then match the shadow rule again and published whole-check notes are simply unused.
